contract: MoveZ is an unbounded per-column fraction with an approach speed. GetXYZPos adds 64 * MoveZ to GetZPos before spline offsets. Absolute position splines replace the entire ArrowEffects position.

native_request.name: native lane MoveZ fractions and approach
native_request.lua_assertions:
local function po(level, name, ...)
    return _ITG_OPTIONS_AT(0, 'ModsLevel_' .. level, name, ...)
end
assert(po('Current', 'MoveZ1') == 0)
po('Song', 'FromString', '*2 150% movez1, *2 -50% movez4')
assert(po('Song', 'MoveZ1') == 1.5)
assert(po('Song', 'MoveZ4') == -0.5)
assert(po('Current', 'MoveZ1') == 0)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(0.5)
assert(po('Current', 'MoveZ1') == 1)
assert(po('Current', 'MoveZ4') == -0.5)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(1)
assert(po('Current', 'MoveZ1') == 1.5)
po('Song', 'MoveZ2', -0.25, 1000)
_ITG_OPTIONS_ADVANCE(1.5)
assert(po('Current', 'MoveZ2') == -0.25)
assert(po('Current', 'MoveZ3') == 0)

native_control.limits: Actual native PlayerOptions parsing, lane setters/getters and approach. Note positioning and spline override rules are established from identical ArrowEffects.h and NoteDisplay.cpp, not a rendered native note field.
